pressure_scope: Linear projected pressure F/(D L)+6M/(D L²);uniform split-ring preload proxy p=2Fbolt/(D L),not contact FEA. Full normal pressure integral varies with actual contact;factor pi assumes uniform full-ring pressure.
bond_scope: Elastic cylindrical Volkersen shear-lag;axial+bending traction envelope and torsion;full compression conservatively assigned to bond despite face bearing.Thermal model deltaCTE20e-6/K assumed.Radial-normal expression is a separate idealized load path,not a computed edge-peel maximum.No cohesive failure/laminate delamination/adhesive plasticity/cure/aging model.
